children: CBOT December corn (CZ26) may retest a support at $5.19 per bushel and fall toward $5.14-3/4.
The bounce from $5.14-3/4 has been shaped into a wedge, which appears to be a bearish continuation pattern, to be confirmed by a break below $5.19 and followed by a round of drop thereafter.
Resistance is at $5.26, a break above which could lead to a gain into $5.29-1/2 to $5.33 range. On the daily chart, the market is stuck in a narrow range of $5.14-1/2 to $5.28-1/4.
Trending signals temporarily turned neutral. The bias might be toward the downside, due to the completion of a five-wave cycle from $4.57-1/4.
